curriculum.lesson_evidence: A data table organises records (rows) and fields (columns). Sorting rearranges rows by a field; it does not invent new facts. Clean field names make sorting and filtering reliable.

lesson.child_mission: A data table organises records (rows) and fields (columns). Sorting rearranges rows by a field; it does not invent new facts. Clean field names make sorting and filtering reliable.
lesson.evidence_instructions: Save the independent response, specific revisions and both short-answer explanations; record oral evidence for speaking tasks.
lesson.extension: Apply the same technology/design idea to a new object or material, then compare two pieces of evidence for strength.
lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
In a table of books with fields Title and Year, what does sorting by Year ascending do?

FEEDBACK
It lists rows from earliest year to latest; titles stay attached to their years.

WATCH FOR
Thinking sort deletes rows that are not first. Sort reorders; it should keep all records.
